name: University of Louisville
academic_ranking: University of Louisville is a public research university (Carnegie R1 - very high research activity). Regularly ranked among national public universities (roughly top ~150-200 nationally in major rankings). Strong programs in business, engineering, health sciences, and nursing. Academic ranking not verified from a live ranking source during this research pass.
financial_aid: Public university; in-state tuition is substantially lower than out-of-state. As a Division I ACC softball program, the NCAA permits up to 12 athletic scholarships (softball is a headcount/equivalency sport at 12.0). Athletic aid is combined with need- and merit-based institutional aid, federal/state grants, and Kentucky programs (e.g., KEES). Exact figures not verified from a live financial-aid page in this pass.
facilities_notes: Home softball venue is Ulmer Stadium on the University of Louisville campus (confirmed via gocards.com softball roster/coaches pages, 2026-07). NCAA D1 ACC-level softball facilities.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC), one of the top Power-conference leagues. Led by head coach Holly Aprile. Established D1 program in a Power 4 conference.
notes: Data captured live from https://gocards.com/sports/softball/coaches and .../roster on 2026-07-30. The gocards.com site is a JavaScript SPA; coach names/titles/emails/phones were extracted from the server-delivered HTML of the coaches page. Coaching staff: 1 head coach, 3 assistant coaches, 1 graduate assistant (5 total). Roster size = 19 (count of player profiles on the 2026 roster page). Conference confirmed as ACC. tuition set to null - could not confirm a live USD figure (louisville.edu bursar page did not list a dollar amount in one hop); University of Louisville is a public school, so in-state tuition is roughly in the low-$13k/yr range and out-of-state substantially higher, but this was NOT verified live and is therefore not entered as a number. scholarship_count reflects the NCAA D1 softball scholarship limit (12.0), not a school-published number. No coach Twitter/X handles are listed on the staff directory. Coach phone numbers on the page are shown as local 852-#### numbers; the University of Louisville campus prefix is 502-852, so full numbers are recorded as 502-852-####.
